placements.why: The content establishes operational resilience practices — rollback rehearsals on a monthly cadence — as architecturally load-bearing rather than optional, calling for a top-level Architecture strata to hold such operational-architecture themes.
placements.title: operational practices treated as structurally load-bearing
placements.frame: What operational practices does the organization treat as architecturally necessary rather than discretionary?

placements.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
placements.frame: Is a capability genuinely possessed only when it has been rehearsed — and does the directive frame that equation as self-evident rather than imposed?
placements.why: Quinton's aphoristic maxim equates an unrehearsed rollback with not having one at all, and the recorder's cadence entry ratifies that principle as a settled operational practice. Both expressions perform the same thematic read: rehearsal is the condition of possession.

placements.title: the recorder converts a directive into a settled organizational fact
placements.frame: How does the act of recording a speaker's directive as a 'key decision' transform a commissive utterance into an institutional commitment?
placements.why: Xena frames the output as 'Key decisions' and assigns ownership to Quinton by name, both enacting authority-ranking from the recorder's seat — curating which utterances count as binding and who is accountable, converting a commissive into a settled organizational record.
